title: feat(distribution): add themed icons and quick-start documentation
actualMessage:
feat(distribution): add themed icons and quick-start documentation (#16)

## Problem

The README mixed first-time setup with detailed operations, and the host
listings lacked a
project icon and immediately usable task examples.

## Resulting behavior

- Add the generated square icon with matching light/dark Codex assets
and a universal Claude
listing asset. Keep one maintained source and verify exact generated
copies and PNG inputs.
- Turn the README into a compact single-column entry page with a themed
128px Hero, four flat
badges in the preview palette, centered version/contents and sequential
host installation.
A shared task example follows installation; lifecycle detail stays in
the user guide.
- Move detailed installation, compatibility, workflow, configuration,
privacy and troubleshooting
into docs/user-guide/. Repair document ownership and installed-guide
links.
- Add three Codex starter prompts for screenshots, console/network
diagnosis and page-load
profiling. Validate the array and keep Claude's supported manifest
fields independent.

Targets still start through the existing Skill and require Close/Keep at
task end. The official
Server release, dependency locks and runtime behavior are preserved.
Version 0.1.0 stays unreleased.

## Verification

- Focused icon/distribution regressions and malformed prompt fixtures
passed.
- Both isolated Marketplace installations passed and discovered 73
tools; installed trees match
    their payloads, including the Codex prompt array and host assets.
- Full supply-chain checks passed: repository signatures 170/170 and
official Server 16/16,
    with no blocked, waived or reported findings.
- Documentation migration, local links and anchors, UTF-8/LF, structure
and factual badges passed.
- pnpm verify:push passed after merging current main and the final
refinements: 558/558 tests,
coverage 93.23% lines, 88.11% branches and 90.30% functions, plus all
audits and typecheck.
- Fixed system temporary-directory aliases in the new icon/repository
fixtures. The expanded
alias regression failed before the fixture correction; all 45 affected
tests then passed.
    Strict production linked-path rejection remains unchanged.
- Independent gpt-6.1-sol Ultra specification and quality reviews passed
for both implementation
tasks and the final integrated branch. GitHub theme/mobile rendering is
checked before merge.

- [x] Focused tests and pnpm verify:push pass.
- [x] Build-input changes passed pnpm check:security.
- [x] Generated host payloads and the standalone security auditor match
their maintained inputs.

- [x] Relevant documentation and meaningful Unreleased changes are
updated.
- [x] The title and atomic commits follow repository policy.
- [x] Version 0.1.0 remains unreleased; no tag or directory publication
is included.
originalBody:
## Problem

The README mixed first-time setup with detailed operations, and the host listings lacked a
project icon and immediately usable task examples.

## Resulting behavior

- Add the generated square icon with matching light/dark Codex assets and a universal Claude
    listing asset. Keep one maintained source and verify exact generated copies and PNG inputs.
- Turn the README into a compact single-column entry page with a themed 128px Hero, four flat
    badges in the preview palette, centered version/contents and sequential host installation.
    A shared task example follows installation; lifecycle detail stays in the user guide.
- Move detailed installation, compatibility, workflow, configuration, privacy and troubleshooting
    into docs/user-guide/. Repair document ownership and installed-guide links.
- Add three Codex starter prompts for screenshots, console/network diagnosis and page-load
    profiling. Validate the array and keep Claude's supported manifest fields independent.

Targets still start through the existing Skill and require Close/Keep at task end. The official
Server release, dependency locks and runtime behavior are preserved. Version 0.1.0 stays unreleased.

## Verification

- Focused icon/distribution regressions and malformed prompt fixtures passed.
- Both isolated Marketplace installations passed and discovered 73 tools; installed trees match
    their payloads, including the Codex prompt array and host assets.
- Full supply-chain checks passed: repository signatures 170/170 and official Server 16/16,
    with no blocked, waived or reported findings.
- Documentation migration, local links and anchors, UTF-8/LF, structure and factual badges passed.
- pnpm verify:push passed after merging current main and the final refinements: 558/558 tests,
    coverage 93.23% lines, 88.11% branches and 90.30% functions, plus all audits and typecheck.
- Fixed system temporary-directory aliases in the new icon/repository fixtures. The expanded
    alias regression failed before the fixture correction; all 45 affected tests then passed.
    Strict production linked-path rejection remains unchanged.
- Independent gpt-6.1-sol Ultra specification and quality reviews passed for both implementation
    tasks and the final integrated branch. GitHub theme/mobile rendering is checked before merge.

- [x] Focused tests and pnpm verify:push pass.
- [x] Build-input changes passed pnpm check:security.
- [x] Generated host payloads and the standalone security auditor match their maintained inputs.

- [x] Relevant documentation and meaningful Unreleased changes are updated.
- [x] The title and atomic commits follow repository policy.
- [x] Version 0.1.0 remains unreleased; no tag or directory publication is included.
